title: Classify
description: Run classify wrangles on the specified columns. Requires WrangleWorks Account and Subscription.

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: ID of the classification model to be used.

parameters.name: include_confidence
parameters.description: For models that support it, include the confidence level in the output.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Run a custom classification wrangle on the specified column or columns. A classification wrangle must be trained first. ## Migrated examples #### Food Type Example ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - classify: input: Products output: Category model_id: ${model_id} where: Products = Milk ```
##### Input Sample | Products | | --- | | Rice | | Milk |
##### Output Sample | Products | Category | | --- | --- | | Rice | | | Milk | Dairy |
